title: Quickly Roasted Quicksilver Quinoa Pilaf
description: A light and quick Ukrainian dish featuring broad beans in a smoky quinoa pilaf, perfect for a date-night meal that's both healthy and flavorful.
instructions: Rinse quinoa and cook according to package instructions, setting aside cooked quinoa after it has cooled slightly.
In a large skillet or wok, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add garlic cloves, sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broad beans, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir well.
Fold in cooked quinoa, mix everything together thoroughly.
Transfer mixture into a baking dish, smoothing out any lumps with your hands or spatula.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown on top.
Remove from oven, sprinkle fresh parsley over the top of pilaf before serving.
